class.name: GameLogHandler
class.brief_description: Where the lines of a [GameLogger] go.
class.description: Registered by name with [method GameLog.register_handler] and assigned to loggers with [method GameLog.assign_handler]; one handler may serve many loggers. The lines below [member min_level] are left out. Override [method _handle] in a script to handle the lines.

method.name: _handle
method.description: A line of the logger [param logger_id], at [member min_level] or above.

members.member: The lowest level of the lines handled.
